items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 21 at 1:18PM EST until November 22 at 2:00AM EST by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 4 to 6 feet in the surf zone.

* WHERE...Charleston County.

* WHEN...Until 2 AM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 21 at 1:15PM EST until November 22 at 4:00PM EST by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 6 to 11 ft.

* WHERE...South Santee River to Edisto Beach out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

items.headline: The Gale Warning has been cancelled.
items.description: The Gale Warning has been cancelled and is no longer in effect.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
